metaDescription: New Red Miracle PLB onion is an F1 hybrid onion variety from Ramgo. See its days to harvest, yield, pest ratings, traits and where it grows best.
keywords: New Red Miracle PLB onion variety
excerpt: New Red Miracle PLB onion is an F1 hybrid onion variety, also sold or known as New Red Miracle PLB F1 or New Red Miracle. It is not on the NSIC registry, so the facts here come from its seller and farm sources. It comes from Ramgo.

heroImage.alt: Onion plants in beds separated by grassy paths on a Philippine farm, the kind of farm where New Red Miracle PLB onion is grown

blocks.text: If you came here looking for New Red Miracle PLB F1 or New Red Miracle, this is the same onion. The facts below come from its seller and from farm sources, each one listed at the end. Compare it with the others in our [onion variety finder](/crop-varieties/onion), or see [every crop variety](/crop-varieties) we list. For the crop itself, read our guide: [Land preparation for onion and garlic](/land-preparation/onion-garlic-land-preparation).

Days to harvest, per the seller

blocks.text: How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

The registry gives no day count or trial yield for this variety. So ask the seller or your municipal agriculturist for figures from farms near you before you plan a season around it.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?
The registry gives no pest or disease ratings for this variety. So treat it as untested, and scout every week.

The pests and diseases that hit onion fields most often: [leafminer](/pests/leafminer), [onion armyworm](/pests/onion-armyworm), [purple blotch of onion](/diseases/purple-blotch), [bacterial soft rot](/diseases/soft-rot), [cutworm](/pests/cutworm). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.
What its seller and farm sources say

items: **Days to harvest:** 85 to 90 days after transplanting.
**Fruit:** Firm, pungent, dark red, double skinned bulbs, fairly round and even in size.
High share of class A bulbs (seller's claim).
Strong plants and good storage (seller's claim).

blocks.text: Why farmers know it: ramgo's newest red onion, launched on 5 August 2025 in Palayan City, Nueva Ecija before about 127 growers, traders and coops, only the seller's pages found. These are the seller's own figures, from its own trials. So plant a small area first, and compare it with your usual onion on the same ground.
Where and when to plant New Red Miracle PLB onion

Red onion stores longer, while yellow onion yields more. Pick a variety that bulbs in the short days of the Philippine dry season, and plant it after the rains so the bulbs dry well. Before planting, get the field ready with our guide: [Pagtatanim ng gulay](/crops/pagtatanim-ng-gulay).

items.q: Is New Red Miracle PLB F1 the same as New Red Miracle PLB?
items.a: Yes. New Red Miracle PLB F1 is another name for New Red Miracle PLB. Seed sellers use both, so ask for either one.
No. It is a hybrid, so seed saved from it does not grow true and yields less. Buy new seed each season.

items.q: Where can I buy seed of New Red Miracle PLB?
items.a: Ask an accredited seed dealer in your province, the seller named on this page or your municipal agriculturist. Look for the certified seed tag or a sealed pack before you pay.
